messages.text: double-clicking AtlasToolbox.exe does nothing, no window and no error. it worked fine before I updated this morning
does it show up in task manager at all, even for a second?
yeah it flashes in for like a second and then disappears
that's the old config it's choking on. delete `%localappdata%\AtlasToolbox` and launch it again, it rebuilds on start
that did it, opens instantly now 🎉 thanks a lot
